Random Forest base predictor + Papadopoulos et al 2002 split-conformal. REAL POSITIVE FINDING: overall test MAE = 1.0826, R² = +0.6991. RadonPy test MAE = 1.1263 (vs Push #33 openpoly-only = 4.0386 = +72.1% improvement). OpenPoly test MAE = 0.9227 (vs Push #23 openpoly-only holdout = 0.4040). 95% PI coverage = 0.9745. DIRECTLY closes Push #33 Phase-1 flag on cross-dataset generalization. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, optimizer, or product-performance authority.
